The season began on 5 March 2026 and is set to conclude on 8 November 2026. ==Teams== The league consisted of ten teams; seven teams remaining from the previous season, two teams promoted from the [[Esiliiga B]], and one team relegated from the [[Meistriliiga]]. The promoted teams were the [[2025 Esiliiga B]] champions [[Maardu Linnameeskond]] and runners-up [[FC Nõmme United U21|Nõmme United U21]]. They replaced the [[2025 Esiliiga]] bottom two teams [[JK Tallinna Kalev U21|Tallinna Kalev U21]] and [[Tartu JK Tammeka U21|Tammeka U21]]. The relegated team was the [[2025 Meistriliiga]] bottom-placed team [[JK Tallinna Kalev|Tallinna Kalev]].
